title: Where 27.78 comes from
notes: Academy 08.4: the 27.78 in the mil relation is now explained — 1000 ÷ 36, a thousandth of the range and 36 inches in a yard.
A step-by-step derivation from lesson 08.1's 3.6 in, and the constant for other units (in → m 25.4, ft → yd 333.3, mm → m 1).
Mental-math method, the small-angle and 1/6400 mil exceptions, and two new quiz questions.
